item.description:
Production Desk 1.4.5

  • Save element names and board IDs as you type, including before quitting or updating.
  • Repair missing shooting schedules when importing backups or opening older workspaces.
  • Reject blank or duplicate shot numbers without blocking workspace saves.
  • Show clear errors for malformed JSON imports and invalid calendar dates.
  • Publish Windows updates only when the application version increases.
